fields.label: 1.7. Is the settlement officially notified by the government?
fields.description:
Notified: officially identified, declared and recorded as a settlement by the Government of Telangana or GHMC; generally eligible for government infrastructure, basic services and welfare.
Non-Notified: a low-income informal settlement (basti) not officially recognised or declared; usually has inadequate housing, limited basic services and insecure tenure.
Resettlement: households covered under a government housing scheme and living in government-constructed housing settlements.

fields.label: 1.8. Is the settlement located in government or private land?
fields.description:
Government: households occupy and live on government land.
Private: households occupy and live on private land, with or without the landlord's permission.

fields.label: 1.9. Category of settlement
fields.options:
A: Settled settlements with Land Tenure
B: Settled settlements without Land Tenure
C: Resettlement Areas
D: Emerging settlements
fields.description:
A: pucca, semi-pucca or tin-roof houses with valid land ownership or occupancy rights (patta, title deed or government authorisation) and access to electricity, drinking water and sanitation.
B: pucca, semi-pucca or tin-roof houses without formal land ownership or legal occupancy rights (encroached government land, private land, or sites without approved permissions or regularised tenure).
C: households under a government housing scheme living in government-constructed housing colonies or rehabilitation settlements with basic infrastructure.
D: newly emerged informal settlements (0-5 years), mostly on the periphery of the city, often of recent migrant families with limited services.

fields.label: 1.10. Is this settlement located close to any of these locations?
fields.options:
A: Along nala
B: Along railway track
C: Industrial area
D: Other (specify)
fields.description:
A: beside a nala/drain or stormwater channel.
B: adjacent to or close to railway tracks or railway land.
C: within or near industrial estates, factories, warehouses or manufacturing units.
D: residential, commercial, roadside, peri-urban or any other area not covered above.
